name: Fighter
body:
Alignment: Any

Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s fighter class levels gains a +1 bonus to attack rolls. This bonus increases by +1 at 5th level and every four levels beyond 5th. At second level, an apprentice gains the fighter’s bravery class feature. When determining the bonus granted by bravery, the apprentice’s effective fighter level is equal to her apprentice level.

Advanced Mentorship Ability

Apprentices who study a mentor’s fighter class levels and chooses fighter for their advanced mentorship ability for the day gains bonus combat feats. The apprentice gains one bonus combat feat for every three apprentice levels he possesses. These bonus combat feats must be combat feats possessed by his mentor. The apprentice must meet all prerequisites for his chosen combat feats but the apprentice’s effective fighter level is equal to his apprentice level for the purpose of meeting the prerequisites of the combat feat.

Cooperation Power

Key abilities: Strength or Dexterity

Apprentices who study a mentor’s fighter class levels and chooses fighter for their cooperation power may, as an immediate action, whenever an ally deals damage with a weapon attack to an enemy within the apprentice’s reach, spend a cooperation point to grant a +2 bonus to that attack’s damage. At 5th level and every three levels thereafter the bonuses for this ability increases by 1 (to a maximum of +8 at 20th level).
